analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see read continues for the third consecutive session. RSI remains at 40.5 in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram improvement has slowed to 518.2180. Volume ratio at 0.79 indicates contraction, lacking clear directional momentum. ADX at 27.3 suggests trend strength, but -DI at 28.8 is above +DI at 21.0, indicating downward pressure. Failure to break the 89,550 KRW swing resistance level could increase selling pressure.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (89,155 KRW) vs SMA5 (92,230 KRW)/SMA20 (93,130 KRW)/SMA50 (102,094 KRW): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100 (109,570 KRW)/SMA200 (100,321 KRW): Below long-term trends, maintaining weakness.
· 52-week position (35.7%) + Current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.4 → 40.5): Exited oversold, now sideways in neutral zone, weakening directional bias.
· MACD histogram trajectory (518.2180 → 518.2180): Slowing improvement, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 93,130 KRW): Sideways near the middle band, lacking direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (85,670 KRW): Confirmed support based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance level (89,550 KRW): Below 5-day high and Pivot PP (95,170 KRW), confirming resistance.
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns: 5-day low (88,350 KRW) > 20-day low (83,410 KRW) suggests potential Higher Low, but 5-day high (97,285 KRW) < 20-day high (112,945 KRW) indicates a Lower High pattern, diagnosing a sideways phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.79x): Contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Lacking clear direction, maintain wait-and-see or enter after confirmation of breaking the 89,550 KRW resistance level.
analysis.patternNote: 일봉상 5일 저가(88,350)가 20일 저가(83,410)보다 높아 Higher Low 가능성을 열어두나, 5일 고가(97,285)가 20일 고가(112,945)보다 낮아 Lower High 패턴으로 횡보 국면 지속.
analysis.patternNoteEn: On the daily chart, the 5-day low (88,350 KRW) is higher than the 20-day low (83,410 KRW), opening potential for a Higher Low, but the 5-day high (97,285 KRW) is lower than the 20-day high (112,945 KRW), indicating a Lower High pattern and continued sideways movement.
